name: Open Merit Scholarships in Junior College
description: School Education Department, Government of Maharashtra invites applications for the Open Merit Scholarships in Junior College, Maharashtra from the students who have secured 60 percent marks in the SSC examination. The objective of this scholarship is to motivate those students for further higher education. The scheme provides scholarship for students studying in 11th and 12th standard.

criteria.label: Applicant must be studying in Class 11 or 12.

evidence.quote: Applicant must be studying in Class 11 or 12.

criteria.label: Applicant must have secured a minimum of 60 percent marks in the SSC examination in First Attempt.

evidence.quote: Applicant must have secured a minimum of 60 percent marks in the SSC examination in First Attempt.

criteria.label: The continuance of scholarships is subject to satisfactory progress and securing at least 50 % marks at the end of the first year of Junior College

benefits.text: For students in class 11th and 12th: INR 50 per month for ten months (Rs. 500 per Year).
